e1.title: Emergency care without upfront payment
e1.desc: Government pays first — refusing treatment is illegal
e1.tip: Call 119 for transport and treatment first; if the hospital blocks you over cost, call 129.

e2.title: Fire & ambulance
e2.desc: 119 — fire, rescue, and emergency medical response
e2.tip: Give address, situation, and headcount in order. If there is smoke, close doors, stay low, evacuate, then call.

e3.title: Police
e3.tip: If you cannot speak, use 112 SMS reporting. Turning on location helps dispatch find you faster.

e4.title: Emergency hospitals & pharmacies
e4.desc: Find open hospitals and pharmacies at night and on holidays
e4.tip: Tell them your area and symptoms to get nearby ERs and pharmacies.

e5.title: Crime victim support
e5.desc: Medical care, counseling, and legal referrals
e5.tip: Support for recovery separate from police investigation—earlier contact helps.

e6.title: Overseas emergency (Korean citizens)
e6.tip: From abroad dial +82-2-3210-0404. After passport loss, accident, or arrest, contact local authorities first, then call.

e7.title: Mental health crisis
e7.tip: Anonymous and free. If you have thoughts of self-harm, also remember 1393.

e13.title: Suicide prevention hotline
e13.tip: If life is in immediate danger, call 119 or 112 first. Counseling: 109 or 1393.

e8.title: Espionage reporting (NIS)
e8.desc: National Intelligence Service — espionage, terror, security threats
e8.tip: Police counter-espionage is 113. Either line accepts reports.

e9.title: Counter-espionage (police)
e9.desc: National Police — espionage, tech leaks, spying
e9.tip: Note exact time, place, and behavior—it helps investigators.

e10.title: Integrated defense hotline
e10.desc: Drones, suspicious vessels, unusual military activity

e11.title: Military secrets & espionage
e11.desc: Military Security Support Command — defense secrets
e11.tip: Use 112 for ordinary crimes; 1337 for military secrets or defense-industry espionage.

e12.title: Coast Guard emergency
e12.tip: At sea, islands, or tidal flats in danger, call 122. Give the island name and precise location.

e14.title: Environmental pollution
e14.desc: Odors, illegal dumping, water and air pollution
e14.tip: State when and where it happened and what kind of pollution you see.

e15.title: Food safety
e15.desc: Food poisoning, unsafe food, false labeling
e15.tip: Product name, store, expiry date, and photos speed up the report.

c1.title: Expressway public tow truck
c1.desc: Avoid private tow scams — free tow to a safe area
c1.tip: On expressways after a crash, call public tow before private tow—free distance may apply.

c2.title: Expressway emergency towing
c2.desc: Breakdown or crash on shoulder — tow to safety zone
c2.tip: Turn on hazards and set a warning triangle before calling. If injured, call 119 first.

c3.title: Traffic accident report
c3.desc: Police dispatch — DUI checks and on-scene investigation
c3.tip: A 112 report before settling creates an official record if a dispute arises.

c5.title: Auto insurance accident line
c5.desc: Roadside assist, towing, and rental car coordination
c5.tip: Save your insurer’s direct number too. On expressways, prefer public tow first.

c6.title: Uninsured driver accident
c6.desc: Compensation when the other party is uninsured or flees

c7.title: Post-accident admin help
c7.desc: Fines, license, and insurance civil-service referrals

c8.title: Transit lost & found
c8.tip: Remember route, time, and seat to recover items. Missing persons: also 182.

c9.title: Rail & KTX customer center
c9.desc: Train schedules, lost items, delay info
c9.tip: Give train number, station where you got off, and time.

h1.title: Bulk address change after moving
h1.desc: Update banks, cards, and insurance in one go
h1.tip: One call after moving updates bank, insurance, and card addresses together.

h2.title: Neighbor noise mediation
h2.desc: Professional mediators visit to help resolve disputes
h2.tip: If the building office cannot help, try the neighbor mediation center. Keep a noise log.

h3.title: Jeonse fraud prevention
h3.desc: Check deposit safety before signing a lease
h3.tip: Call before sending jeonse deposit. Urgent-only deals or agents-only meetings are red flags.

h4.title: Gas leak emergency
h4.tip: If you smell gas, do not touch switches—ventilate, evacuate, then report.

h5.title: Power outage & electrical faults
h5.tip: Electrocution or fire risk: 119 first. Simple outage: 123.

h6.title: Water supply & quality
h6.desc: K-water — outages and water quality info
h6.tip: City water leaks may be faster via local 120. Unsure? try 110.

h7.title: Weather alerts
h7.desc: Typhoon, heavy rain, heat wave, and cold wave advisories
h7.tip: Check weather alerts before hiking, boating, or outdoor plans.

l1.title: Free legal aid
l1.tip: Free legal help may be available by income—consult before suing.

l2.title: Hospital bill refund
l2.desc: Refund when costs exceed the out-of-pocket cap
l2.tip: If you paid a lot out-of-pocket in a year with no refund notice, ask here.

l3.title: Financial consumer protection
l3.desc: Illegal finance and financial product harm
l3.tip: If they rush a transfer, hang up and call 1398. Product complaints: 1332.

l4.title: Voice phishing report
l4.desc: Report even while a scam call is in progress
l4.tip: Hang up on fake prosecutors or regulators and call 1398 immediately—before transferring money.

l5.title: Personal data breach
l5.desc: Leaks and misuse — deletion and blocking guidance

l9.title: Cybercrime & hacking
l9.tip: Voice phishing: 1398. Hacking or phishing sites: 118.

l10.title: Drugs & prosecution crimes
l10.desc: Drugs and special investigations — prosecution services

d1.title: Telecom & broadcasting complaints
d1.desc: Billing and service issues for telecom and TV
d1.tip: If the carrier cannot help, you can file a telecom/broadcast complaint at 1335.

d3.title: Broadcast & telecom review
d3.desc: Harmful or illegal broadcast and telecom content

d4.title: Illegal spam report
d4.tip: Spam and phishing sites: 118. Active voice phishing: 1398.

l6.title: Consumer dispute mediation
l6.tip: Have contract, payment proof, and chat logs ready.

l7.title: National tax inquiry (NTS)
l7.desc: Income tax, VAT, and tax counseling

l8.title: Local tax inquiry
l8.desc: Vehicle tax and property tax counseling

l11.title: Fair trade counseling
l11.desc: Unfair practices, ads, and franchise disputes
l11.tip: Individual refund fights are often better at Consumer Agency 1544-0990.

l12.title: Credit recovery & debt adjustment
l12.tip: Try public debt counseling before illegal loan sharks.

l13.title: Microfinance counseling
l13.desc: Policy loans such as Sunshine Loan

f1.title: Elder care counseling
f1.desc: Wellness checks and in-home care referrals

f2.title: School violence report
f2.desc: Report by phone or text message
f2.tip: Consider a public report in addition to school-internal steps.

f3.title: Women's emergency hotline
f3.tip: Immediate danger: also 112. Counseling is confidential.

f4.title: Illegal filming victim support
f4.tip: Do not delete evidence on your own—follow counselor guidance for takedown and investigation.

f6.title: Youth counseling
f6.desc: Anonymous help with school, family, and careers

f8.title: Elder abuse report
f8.desc: Abuse and neglect counseling and protection
f8.tip: Urgent danger: 112. Financial abuse and neglect also count.

f9.title: Missing child or person
f9.tip: Prepare recent photos, clothing, and last known location.

w1.title: Unemployment benefits & employment aid
w1.desc: Ministry of Employment and Labor counseling
w1.tip: Unpaid wages or unfair dismissal guidance is also available at 1350.

w2.title: Workers' comp & employment insurance
w2.tip: After a workplace injury, check industrial-accident filing deadlines.

w4.title: Workplace bullying & harassment
w4.tip: Use this public channel if internal reporting is hard or you fear retaliation.

g1.title: Government call center
g1.desc: Connect to agencies and civil services nationwide
g1.tip: Not sure who to call? start with 110.
